alerts.title: Credential harvest attempt reported by user
alerts.rawAlert: User mira@contoso.example reported a credential harvesting page at https://evil-login.example/login that mimics the Contoso SSO portal. No credentials were entered; the page was reported by the user's mail client.

alerts.title: Suspicious encoded PowerShell with scheduled task persistence
alerts.rawAlert: EDR detected powershell.exe running with -enc on fin-db-01 (user FIN\svc-backup): the base64 payload decodes to a script that registers a scheduled task named WinUpdate and opens an outbound connection to the c2 server 203.0.113.77. Host fin-db-01.

alerts.title: PowerShell maintenance script flagged on ops-ws-04
alerts.rawAlert: The PowerShell script inventory-check.ps1 ran on ops-ws-04 during admin maintenance; the binary is signed by Contoso IT and was distributed as an approved software update.

alerts.title: Suspicious PowerShell command-and-control activity on web-01
alerts.rawAlert: WAF and EDR jointly reported suspicious PowerShell activity on web-01: a powershell.exe process issued a command-and-control beacon to an external endpoint every 60 seconds.
